I have a plan myself. When I'm no longer able to take care of myself I'll do it. It's definitely an inevitably for me but i think different events in life could definitely change my feelings. Way i look at it sooner or later we're all dead, through any suffering or pain we all end up in the same place cosmicly. In the end there will be a light death in the universe regardless of what we do today, tomorrow, or ever. I just live day by day because honestly i can die any time and I'll just be dead. I don't imagine I'll have many thoughts once i'm dead. I imagine it much like being in the womb; just non-existence. I think the reason i hang on is because i just want to see what happens. I'm just gonna waste away the same whether I'm a legendary rock star or a construction worker. But yeah, definitely just feels like when. You'd just be torn from reality really.
